   - **Mobile & Wireless Printing Support - **Q**: Can I print directly from my Apple iPhone or iPad?** - **A**: Yes.
The ApexPrint ProX-400 and ColorWave-850 natively support Apple AirPrint.
Connect your iOS device to the same Wi-Fi network as the printer, tap the Share icon in any app, select Print, and choose your ApexPrint printer.
No additional drivers or apps are required.
- **Q: Can I print from Android devices?** - **A**: Yes.
Devices running Android 8.0 or later can print directly using the pre-installed Mopria Print Service or the free ApexPrint Mobile Connect app available on Google Play.

- **Print Resolution**: True optical resolution of 1200 x 1200 dpi with 2400-class image enhancement smoothing technology.
- **Processor & Memory**: 1.2 GHz dual-core ARM processor with 1 GB standard memory (expandable up to 2.5 GB via DDR3 SO-DIMM slot).
